q: By March 31, 2027, volume-production shipments of HBM3 or HBM3E by CXMT (excluding samples, risk production, and units for qualification testing) are confirmed by an official CXMT announcement or by reports from at least two of Reuters, Bloomberg, TrendForce, and DigiTimes
basis: The Information reported on August 31, 2026, that CXMT had supplied HBM3E from risk production to Alibaba and Cambricon for testing. On the other hand, CXMT's HBM3 yields remain at 25 to 30 percent, and there are reports that CXMT's IPO prospectus includes no dedicated HBM business. The probability reflects the precedent of SMIC's 7nm chips, which were pushed into shipment with subsidies despite low yields. · AI and Chips issue
rs: An official CXMT announcement, or reporting by at least two of Reuters, Bloomberg, TrendForce and DigiTimes
